short: The Den read over HTTP: GET /den and GET /den/{*path}
is: The den route group: a thin driver over `application::den` that checks the session (`CallingUser`), then parses the raw query string by hand, then splits the raw request path on `/` and percent-decodes each piece once, and maps the application's outputs onto den.proto's generated types. Every miss is the one `node_not_found`; every answer carries `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.
conventions: Order, so no check depends on what exists: the session (401), then the query (400 unknown parameter, 422 repeated or unusable value), then the path.
The path is never read through axum's path extractors, which decode `%2F` inside a wildcard: the raw `Uri` path is stripped of `/den/`, split on `/`, then each piece is decoded exactly once.
The viewer is the session's user, from `CallingUser` only; nothing in the path, the query or a header names a viewer or a root.
Query keys and values are decoded exactly once with the same strict decoder as the path pieces: `+` stays `+`, a broken `%` escape or non-UTF-8 bytes refuse the key (400) or the value (422).
`DenError::NotFound` and an undecodable piece answer `Problem::node_not_found()`; `DenError::Store` is the house's 500 from `From<anyhow::Error>`, never rendering its cause.

The only log line is the fixed `a den read failed in a store`, on a 500, carrying the matched route template and nothing else: never the cause, a Den path, a piece, a page token or the viewer's DID. Nothing `Debug`-prints `RootQuery` or `NodeQuery`.
At most 17 raw pieces are decoded (one past the 16-piece cap), so a longer path still reaches the application's not-found without decoding the rest.

The API never names Atta in Rust and never depends on it directly; it reaches it only through `application` (guard tests in `api/tests/den.rs`; `application/tests/atta_exposure.rs` keeps Atta's types out of the application's public items).

fs.name: errors.rs
fs.role: the From impls into Problem (query 400/422, undecodable path 404, DenError 404/500) and read_problem, which logs the fixed 500 line

fs.name: params.rs
fs.role: DenParams and its FromStr over the raw query: includeDeleted, pageToken, each at most once

fs.name: percent.rs
fs.role: PercentDecoded: strict decode-once of percent-encoded UTF-8

fs.name: pieces.rs
fs.role: DenPieces: the raw path split on `/`, at most 17 pieces kept, then each decoded once

fs.name: router.rs
fs.role: den_router (/den, /den/, /den/{*path}) under the private, no-store layer, and the two handlers

fs.name: wire.rs
fs.role: the application's den outputs into the generated den.proto types
